# Qwen Code 0.23.3 identity fixture

This fixture freezes the official `@qwen-code/qwen-code` npm package and
matching QwenLM/qwen-code `v0.23.0` through `v0.23.3` release/tag evidence
used by Research 310. The package contents were extracted for hashing only;
no downloaded artifact was executed and no provider request was made.

`identity.json` records the official channel metadata, host observation, and
the compatible-extension decision. `protocol.json` records the selected
headless surface and the bounded classification of changed upstream files.
`dist-inventory.json` is the complete extracted package path/hash inventory
for every published stable hop after the previous `0.22.3` ceiling.
